relationship_to_existing_apps: Additive. Wing AeroStruct (index.html), Wing Lab, Truss Lab, their solvers and RELEASE.json are unchanged. No page in this folder reads or replaces their solvers.
scope: Ten self-contained educational pages on simplified linear-elastic models (Euler-Bernoulli beams, 2D direct-stiffness trusses, a thin-walled single-cell wing box). Deterministic optimizers only; every recommended design is re-solved from scratch by the exact solver of its page before it is shown. Indicative checks (Euler and plate buckling with assumed boundary conditions) are labelled screens. No certified strength, stability or fatigue statements; representative educational material cards; no experimental validation.

browser_smoke_test.tool: In-app browser, observed all ten pages and hub; actual default campaigns completed
browser_smoke_test.result: Default pages executed; follow-up checks cover invalid input and compressed-wire refusal. Original export smoke script was not included.

review_status: Independent source, analytic, randomized and browser review; see validation/REVIEW.json. No experimental or commercial FEA validation.
known_limitations: Linear elastic, small displacement models; pin-jointed trusses; single-cell thin-walled wing box without aeroelastic feedback.
Buckling checks are screens with assumed effective length or edge conditions.
CSV and PNG downloads need a normal browser origin (GitHub Pages or a local server); they are blocked inside the Claude artifact viewer frame.
ES module pages do not run from file:// in Chrome; serve the folder over HTTP.
Singular or cycling tension-only active sets are withheld, not stabilized with compressive cables. A withheld branch is not a proof that every possible nonlinear equilibrium is impossible.
Member sizing defaults to Warren. Compressed wires in any bilateral linear comparison prevent physical design admission; reliability is withheld.
